notes: Source 1: own-row 'water installations', 'water system', 'aqueduct', 'quarry' and S1295 'fosse' not coded (no pool, pit or grave named). S1322, S1208, S1357 and E150 (empty) hold no pool, pit or grave. E151 is the Excavations-sheet row at the same point (0 m, bearing invalid). S1268 'probably tumuli' coded as grave (burial mounds), hedged in the source. Source 2: f13 measured on Fig. 339 from the summit centre to the three drawn cisterns (about 90-113 deg, 98-107 m); the plan's half-arrow is tilted about 10 deg west of page-up, used as north. f12 is the unlocated header count, which may include cisterns not drawn on the plan. f19 measured on Abel's Fig. 335 from the acropolis outline to the 'citerne' label (no symbol); scale 0-400 m; uncertainty about +/-50 m. f14 groups the five robbing pits; the Zschokke (Fig. 334, 'Vertiefungen') and Bar-Adon (Fig. 337) plans show the same pits and are not coded again. Zertal p. 461 also identifies f21 (SWP pits) with these robbing pits. The robbing date is coded U because the source hedges its 19th-c. deduction. Zertal's SW 'large excavation' (robbing dig / foundation trench), the western moat, and Moulton's 'depression' are trenches or digs, not coded as pits. The water system (Site 171), Lower Sartaba (Site 172) and siege works (Site 165) are referred elsewhere and not excerpted. f16 'east part' and f15 'E' rest on D: excavations 'in the east side of the site, below the summit' (also A.4 eastern slope). Source 3: f21 lies 'Forty-four feet from the north end of the central foundation' -- distance from a part of the site, no direction word, so position none. f20 cave-cisterns: the aqueduct line runs 'on the north side of the hill' and supplies them, but no direction is given for the cisterns themselves, so position none. Mem II p. 49 (El Mugheir, Section A) names Kurn Surtubeh only for identifications and roads; its caves at el Makhruk are a different place, not shown within 2 km; ignored. Source 4: no burial or water remains located on the ground; family tomb and the general cistern statement coded with position none. No explicit absence statement in any source.
